title: Nutrition and weight management in Greater Cairo
description: Book a nutrition consultation in New Cairo or Mohandessin. Learn what to bring, how to build a practical meal plan and how follow-up supports weight goals.
h1: Nutrition and weight management in Greater Cairo
answer: Nutrition consultations at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin help people plan meals around their health, routine and weight goals. The visit reviews eating patterns, medicines and previous diets before agreeing on practical changes. Follow-up considers how the plan feels in daily life and whether it needs adjustment.
preparation: Bring a typical day's meals, your medicines and available test results. An unexplained change in weight or eating disorder symptoms need medical assessment.
howPerformed: The team discusses goals and practical barriers, agrees realistic meal changes with you and arranges a follow-up to review progress.
followup: A dietary consultation involves no procedure or healing period. Track how the adjustments affect appetite, energy and daily routines.
risks: Restrictive diets can lead to nutritional gaps. Diabetes medicines, pregnancy and other medical needs affect how a plan should be adapted.
